detailed_description: Random Picker selects one or more winners from a newline-separated list in the browser. Paste or type one item per line, choose how many winners to pick, and click Pick to run a short shuffle animation before the selected winners appear. The page shows the current item count, limits the winner count to the number of available items, and includes a Clear button after a selection starts so you can reset the result.
usage_steps: Enter one item per line in the item list textarea.
Check the item count shown below the list.
Set the number of winners you want to select.
Click Pick to run the shuffle animation and select the winners.
Review the numbered winners list or use Clear to reset the current result.
usage_examples: Pick one student name from a classroom list.
Select several giveaway winners from a list of entries.
Choose a lunch option from a short newline-separated list.
Randomly order a few task volunteers by setting the winner count above one.
